rationale: The generic PRACTICAL_ILLUSTRATION composer is already proven and merged. This change loads an explicitly human-approved illustration profile by governed concept and transports it through the existing authority-enforced real-response dependency chain so Case A can compose education with approved typed product facts.
authority_impact: No new insurance authority. The profile repository admits only explicitly APPROVED reviewed illustration data; operative duration remains Decision-Gate-approved product evidence. Illustration profiles cannot satisfy reasoning/evidence requirements and do not modify Decision Gate output.
